subject: PO cutoff, regional tax handling & invoice-splitting request
messages:
From: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@medicorehealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medicorehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: PO and invoicing cadence questions for Redwood

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed. Procurement has a couple of constraints we need to confirm before we proceed:

- Our ERP requires a PO per legal entity; Medicore has three billing entities across US states where services will be consumed. Can Redwood issue invoices split by legal entity (so we can apply local tax handling)?
- We typically require a PO line that maps to subscription seats and a separate PO line for variable overage/usage charges. Is that supported in your billing payload?
- Standard net terms are Net 45 for our vendors. Is Net 45 acceptable, or do you need Net 30?
- Finally, our finance team prefers monthly invoices aligned to our fiscal month cutoff (close on the 28th). Alternatively, we could consolidate to quarterly billing — is there any pricing impact for moving to quarterly consolidated invoices?

Can you confirm what fields Redwood needs on the PO and whether you can split by entity? We want to finalize the PO and get this to legal next week.

Appreciate it,
Alicia Turner
Sr. Procurement Manager
Medicore Health
From: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO and invoicing cadence questions for Redwood

Hi Alicia — great to hear from you, and glad the demo landed. Quick answers up front, then details below:

- Yes, we can emit separate invoices per legal entity, provided each entity is tied to a distinct customer-account mapping in our system (we'll need the legal entity name + tax ID and the ERP entity code).
- We support multiple PO lines: subscription (recurring) + usage/overage as separate line items. Please include line descriptions and the PO number mapping for each.
- Net 45 is doable for enterprise customers with credit approval; we'll need a standard credit form and signoff from finance.
- Quarterly consolidated invoices are possible. If Medicore moves from monthly to quarterly consolidated billing and commits to an annual minimum, we can extend a 2.0% invoice consolidation discount (applies to recurring subscription charges only).

I'm attaching our enterprise-billing-guidelines.pdf for the ERP field list and the required PO metadata we need. Vanessa (cc'd) will confirm the credit/Net45 process and what information we need for entity-level invoices. Karthik can advise on contract language for PO referencing multiple entities.

Next steps I propose:
1) Medicore to provide a draft blanket PO with entity mappings (PO number + entity code per line) by 2026-11-10.
2) Redwood finance (Vanessa) to confirm credit approval timeline.
3) Karthik to prepare a short amendment clause for multi-entity invoicing.

Would you like us to produce an example invoice payload (JSON sample) to share with your ERP team?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0183

Attachment: enterprise-billing-guidelines.pdf (2 pages)
From: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@medicorehealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medicorehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-02T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO and invoicing cadence questions for Redwood

Jordan — thanks for the quick response. A couple follow-ups from our side:

- Yes, we can provide entity name + tax ID + ERP entity code. Is it acceptable if we issue one blanket PO that references multiple entity sub-lines (we prefer a single blanket PO number to ease procurement reporting)?
- For the quarterly consolidation discount, can you confirm whether the discount applies retroactively if we switch mid-term or only prospectively from the first consolidated invoice?
- Also, does Redwood require the PO line to contain a Redwood SKU, or can we use our internal cost-center code as long as the PO line has a free-text description? Our ERP enforces cost-center codes on PO lines.

We can share a draft blanket PO by next Tuesday (11/09). A sample invoice payload would be very helpful for our ERP team.

Thanks,
Alicia
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-03T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO and invoicing cadence questions for Redwood

Hi Alicia — Vanessa from Finance here. Quick clarifications to make sure your ERP can reconcile automatically:

- Blanket PO with sub-lines: acceptable. We require that each sub-line include: PO Number, Sub-Line ID, Legal Entity Code (your ERP code), Tax ID (EIN), and the start/end service dates. Our system uses Sub-Line ID to route invoices to each legal entity.
- PO line content: Redwood prefers a Redwood SKU field, but we can accept your internal cost-center code if you include a mapped Redwood SKU in the PO line 'metadata' column. If your ERP cannot carry both, we can accept the cost-center code but will need a separate mapping spreadsheet that ties cost-center -> Redwood SKU for reconciliation.
- Quarterly discount rules: the 2.0% consolidation discount applies prospectively from the first consolidated invoice after the agreed switch date. We do not apply it retroactively to invoices already posted.

Attached is a short spreadsheet (erp-field-requirements.xlsx) that lists mandatory fields and example payload snippets for our AR system. For Net45 credit, please include a credit reference form and three months of trade references; our team will aim to turn around approval within 7 business days of receipt.

If you can send the draft blanket PO and the entity mapping spreadsheet, I will provision the billing entities and confirm the invoice payload sample for your ERP team.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: erp-field-requirements.xlsx (1 sheet)
From: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-05T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO and invoicing cadence questions for Redwood — MAP and next steps

Alicia — thanks, that all sounds actionable. Summarizing the mutual action plan so everyone is aligned:

- Medicore to provide: draft blanket PO with sub-line entity mappings + entity tax IDs + cost-center -> Redwood SKU mapping (if you can't include both on PO lines) by 2026-11-09.
- Redwood to provide: example invoice payload and mapping template (Jordan) + finance to start Net45 credit review on receipt (Vanessa) within 7 business days.
- Contract amendment: Karthik will draft a short addendum for multi-entity invoicing and the quarterly consolidation discount language by 2026-11-12.

If you confirm the timeline, I'll mark the opportunity in our system (OPP-2026-4931) and route a DocuSign template for the amendment once Karthik has prepared the language.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if procurement or ERP teams want to walk through the invoice sample.

Best,
Jordan

--

Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
